overview.text: Microlancer presents a general microtask board with tasks priced in Bitcoin satoshis, offer counts and site-reported paid labels. Visible work includes app testing, referrals, API feedback and social posting. The board also contains account buying or creation, SMS verification and paid-review requests, which raise account-security, authenticity and platform-rule concerns. Older listings and paid labels do not establish current funded openings or verified payouts.
